assumptions: All mutating entrypoints acquire the exclusive writer lock and reload persisted state under that lock before refreshing or scheduling; those callers are not supplied.

Acceptance creation binds all required checker inputs, outputs and review evidence into evidence_hashes. The supplied refresh code verifies recorded hashes but cannot establish whether that inventory is complete.
proposal_gate independently validates current readiness evidence, and consumers reject mismatched derived-view generations or rebuild them from canonical state.
Trusted workers remain in their initial process group, as specified.
checks: Accepted evidence with missing hashes, changed bytes, changed phase contracts or changed prerequisite evidence becomes stale.
The second invalidation pass follows the validated topological catalog order, propagating stale prerequisite status through accepted descendants.
Eligibility excludes held implementation work, requires accepted prerequisites and suppresses unchanged external blocks and deferred inputs.
Observed checkpoint disappearance vetoes reload and save rather than recreating cached state.
Refresh commits canonical state before publishing derived views and includes current outcomes, issues, residuals and next actions.
State validation requires mission_complete=false and every original gap to remain open.
residuals: Lock acquisition, acceptance inventory construction, atomic-write implementation, proposal_gate and derived-view consumers are supplied as interfaces rather than executable bodies. Their guarantees remain interface assumptions for this bounded review.
The derived files are published separately. Handled interruption can leave mixed generations until refresh rebuilds them; downstream consumers must enforce the stated freshness assumption.
Directory retry fingerprints exclude symlink files. The packet does not specify whether such files are forbidden as retry inputs or have their resolved targets bound elsewhere.
The reported 210 passing tests and listed test names are supporting control-plane evidence; their bodies were not supplied or executed.
This review establishes no accounting correctness, scientific completeness or human acceptance for the 192-report source panel or proposal.
steps: Reviewed only the supplied state validation, persistence, invalidation, fingerprinting and refresh code against the stated interfaces.
Traced checkpoint loss, upstream evidence changes, phase-contract changes and interruption between canonical and derived publication without using tools.
response.summary: AGREE for the bounded state-refresh packet: no concrete blocking defect is established in the supplied code under the explicitly stated interface assumptions. This verdict does not extend to omitted controller implementations.
